content.text:
I submitted index 0 (Sb fraction 0.055) as the best composition. At 0.130%, it had the highest EQE of the five I measured.

All five EQE measurements are used. The results fall steadily as Sb goes up:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.055 | 0.130 |
| 4 | 0.080 | 0.115 |
| 14 | 0.234 | 0.103 |
| 21 | 0.426 | 0.101 |
| 28 | 0.630 | 0.074 |

Index 0 is the lowest-Sb composition on the line, so if the trend holds there is nothing higher beyond it. I didn't measure the gaps between points, though. A narrow peak somewhere else, most plausibly between Sb 0.08 and 0.23, is still possible.

The whole line has very low photoresponse (all values are between 0.07% and 0.13%). I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements or the phase and band-gap models, so this choice rests only on the EQE numbers.
